lines.text: Two futures share one name: AGI.
The first is ARTIFICIAL: a mind of its own, standing apart from us.
But a second future hides in the same three letters.
Look what it's made of: the same six parts, every time.
The LLM: the language model, the raw intelligence.
A HARNESS: the layer wrapped around it.

lines.text: HOOKS: automatic checks, firing at the right moment.
TOOLS: what it can reach and do.
Now wear them: a digital CORTEX, around your own mind.
Who OWNS the layer around the model?
ARTIFICIAL stands apart, and belongs to someone else.
AUGMENTED is worn by you, and belongs to you.
